svg.aria-label: Lifecycle of one deal email, top to bottom. Claude steps are always followed by a deterministic check. Each failed check leads to a named state: a question to the AE, an escalation to the CS Manager, or a parked run that novacrm resume can finish without calling the AE again.
svg.title: How one deal moves through the agents
svg.text: How one deal moves through the agents
ESCALATED = the Escalator emails the CS Manager, labels the email and posts to #cs-escalations. Any other unexpected exception also lands here, so a deal is never lost silently.
Poll the CS inbox every 15 s
UNIQUE in the run store, so a repeat is skipped before any work happens
No new run, no side effects
Structured output: every field with a verbatim evidence snippet
Fields present, verbatim in the email, well formed; sender is a registered AE
Replies on the thread with what is missing
Retell agent calls the AE (web call in the demo)
Asks the tier, reads it back. A tier written in the email is ignored
Independent read of the transcript, only when the call connected
Accept only if: connected, one tier, read-back yes, and Claude agrees
3 calls unreached or 2 unclear. No default tier
Template from config, keyed by the confirmed tier
Enterprise 30 days, Growth 14 days. The LLM never chooses
Active project for this customer? This run's own earlier attempt is adopted instead
Enterprise: round-robin dedicated CSM. Growth: pooled queue
3 attempts with backoff; looks for the project before any re-POST
CS Manager told, deal and tier kept
Lists the tasks: expects 15 tasks across 4 phases
Saved on the run, so the Slack step can be retried on its own
onb-<customer-slug>-ent|grw, with a tier-specific topic and purpose
Written only from the facts it is given
Must name the customer, days and CSM; nothing from the other tier
Run continues with the safe message
Post welcome and plan link; invite the CSM and AE
Customer Slack Connect invite is mocked (needs a paid Slack plan)
Email labelled novacrm-processed; the CSM takes over in Rocketlane and Slack
AE replies: new run, prior run SUPERSEDED, whole thread re-read
novacrm resume: back to the project step, no second call to the AE
novacrm resume: retries only the Slack step
